The state's population of 29,66,889 (as per the 2011 Census), with 80% residing in rural areas marked by challenging terrains and inadequate connectivity, heavily relies on government healthcare facilities. The current healthcare system in the state is intricate, with a predominant emphasis on curative rather than preventive care. However, recognizing the evolving healthcare landscape, there is now a concerted effort to prioritize preventive measures alongside promoting positive health outcomes. One of the most pressing challenges facing Meghalaya's healthcare sector is the acute shortage of human resources. The doctor-to-population ratio significantly falls below the WHO standard, severely impacting the quality of healthcare services. With only a modest number of government doctors serving the populace, particularly in remote areas, the need for effective recruitment strategies becomes paramount to bridge this gap and ensure equitable access to healthcare services. The Council had introduced NATA in 2006 after receiving requests from various schools of Architecture in the country to conduct a Common Architecture Entrance Test for admission to Ist year of 5-year B.Arch. degree course. text: Communiqué from the Chairman, Members’ Facilities & Services Committee. Respected Professional Colleagues, I once again express my thanks and gratitude to you for giving me an opportunity to serve the Central Council. I feel privileged for being given the opportunity to head the Members’ Facilities & Services Committee as Chairman for another term (2016–17), for which I am thankful to the President, Vice President and the Council, ICAI. During the year 2015-16, the main focus of the Committee was, among other things, on expanding the membership base and on improving the interface between the esteemed members / prospective members and the Institute. We shall continue on improving the service and I am delighted to inform you that for all online payments related to membership, members will no longer need to pay any convenience charge, as was done earlier, for payments made through netbanking/debit/credit card. I urge and welcome members and new applicants to extensively use the “Members’ Online System”. I call upon all final passed students having the requisite experience to immediately apply for Associate membership. I also urge members to avail the benefits of Members Benevolent Fund (MBF) for the members of the Institute by becoming life members of the MBF. I would also like to bring to the notice of members who have not yet paid membership fees for 2016-17, that membership fee dues need to be paid by 30 September 2016 to continue enjoying the benefits of membership. text: Application for Scribe/ Compensatory Time Advertisement Select GPSC/202627/33 - Senior Drugs Inspector, Class-2 Confirmation No Birth Date (dd/mm/yyyy) Enter Captcha Ok લહિયો / વળતર સમય મેળવવા માટેની અગત્યની સુચનાઓ : આયોગની જાહેરાતો ની પરીક્ષામાં લહિયો(SCRIBE) / વળતર સમય (COMPENSATORY TIME) ની સુવિધા મેળવવા માટે ઉમેદવારોએ પરીક્ષા માટે ડાઉનલોડ કરેલ પ્રવેશપત્ર માં દર્શાવેલ Confirmation Number થી લોગીન કરી અરજી કરવાની રહેશે. લહિયા / વળતર સમય ની મંજુરી અંગે પત્ર ડાઉનલોડ કરવા અહીં ક્લિક કરો. https://gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in/ScribeApplicationReceipt.aspx × લહિયા / વળતરની સુવિધા મેળવવાના ફોર્મ ભરવા અંગે અગત્યની સૂચનાઓ : - (1) સંબંધિત જાહેરાતની જોગવાઈ મુજબ જાહેરાતમાં અરજી કરવાને પાત્ર ગણેલ હોય તેવા Benchmark disability ધરાવતા અને આકસ્મિક પરિસ્થિતિઓના કારણે હંગામી દિવ્યાંગતા ધરાવતા હોય તેવા લખવા માટે અક્ષમ/લખવામાં તકલીફ હોય તેવા ઉમેદવારોએ લહિયા/વળતર સમયની સુવિધા મેળવવા માટે લહિયા/વળતર સમય મેળવવા ઓનલાઈન અરજી કરવની રહેશે. (2) હવે પછીથી યોજાનાર તમામ પરીક્ષાઓ માટે ઉમેદવારોએ લહિયા/વળતર સમયની સુવિધા મેળવવા માટે ઓનલાઈન પોર્ટલ પર ફરજિયાતપણે પરીક્ષાની તારીખ અગાઉ ઓછામાં ઓછા ૦૨ (બે) દિવસ પહેલા ઓનલાઈન અરજી કરવાની રહેશે. તે પછી કરેલ અરજી માન્ય ગણાશે નહી. (3) લહિયા અને વળતર સમય માટે કરેલ અરજી સંબંધે કોઈ QUERY/ સ્પષ્ટતા ઉમેદવારનાં અરજી કરતી વખતે રજીસ્ટર્ડ મોબાઈલ નંબર તથા ઈ-મેલ પર કરવામાં આવશે. માટે ઉમેદવારે પોતાના ઈ-મેલ તથા મેસેજ જોતા રહેવાનું અને નિયત સમય-મર્યાદામાં સ્પષ્ટતા મોકલી આપવાની રહેશે. કોઈપણ વિલંબનાં લીધે લહિયા/વળતર સમય મંજૂર ન થાય તેની સંપૂર્ણ જવાબદારી ઉમેદવારની રહેશે. (4) લહિયા/વળતર સમય

The current healthcare system in the state is intricate, with a predominant emphasis on curative rather than preventive care. However, recognizing the evolving healthcare landscape, there is now a concerted effort to prioritize preventive measures alongside promoting positive health outcomes. text: Guidelines for submission of online application form Guidelines for submission of online application form The following guidelines may be read by all applicants before filling the application form for Admission to AILET 2027: The candidates are advised to go through the admission notification carefully and acquaint themselves with all requirements in respect to filling up of the Online Application Form. It will be the sole responsibility of the candidate to make sure that he/she is eligible and fulfils all the conditions prescribed for admission in particular programme. The fee paid for application for admission shall not be refundable. Incomplete application form will be summarily rejected and no request will be entertained in this regard. Name of the Candidate: Candidates should type his / her Name as given in Class X or equivalent certificate. If your name has several initials, leave one blank after each of them. Email address/Mobile Number: Candidates should type his/her correct mobile number and email address only which will be used for sending various communications related to AILET 2027. Name of Father / Mother: Type the name of your Father or Mother exactly as in your Class X or equivalent certificate. Date of Birth: Enter the date, month and year of your birth as per English calendar and as recorded in your School / Board (Class - X) / Pre-University examination certificate. Gender: Select the correct option. Category: Select the appropriate option for your categorie

text: Frequently Asked Questions Nagaland Teacher Eligibility Test Login Register Now FAQ ❓ Frequently Asked Questions N-TET Exam — Common Queries × 1 Is N-TET mandatory for in-service teachers? ▾ Reference source 2 I didn't receive any login password email but the exam site says my password has been sent to my registered email id. Where can I find it? ▾ Email providers tend to block automated mail sent from an institution/company/website so they are most likely to end up not getting listed in your inbox. Check your spam box. You will find your password under the email titled "LOGIN CREDENTIALS" 3 Am I supposed to create two accounts for each papers (Paper-I and Paper-II)? ▾ No, there's an option to appear for both papers. It's listed as "Both (Paper-I) and (Paper-II)" 4 What if I have already applied for a single paper and now I want to apply for both? ▾ Contact us to have your exam account modified/updated. Helpline contact information provided below. 5 Can I apply for N-TET if I am still currently pursuing my D.El.Ed or B.Ed course? ▾ Only if you have appeared for the final year/semester exam and your result is awaited then yes you are eligible to apply for the N-TET exam. Candidates are eligible with final semester B.Ed or D.El.Ed admit card. The prerequisite is you have to have successfully completed any of the above mentioned professional courses to be applicable for the TET exam. 6 I made a mistake with my name, father's/mother's name, DoB, etc. Can I update it? ▾ Yes.
